answer: New identities start on a cold tundra: for twenty epochs each is audited by recomputation on one task in three, while veterans face one in fifty. Auditors are drawn by a stake-weighted yarrow that rotates every epoch, so no operator can predict which sibling redoes which job. A thousand fresh keys therefore owe a thousand independent recomputations before casting a single vote, and one mismatch freezes every sibling bond. A falcon strike is fast, but speed buys nothing when the cost is idle capacity held ready, and that is what a farm cannot hide.
